arguments.question: Across ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, assess the 21/63-session macro and policy transmission channels using current primary Fed/FRED evidence: rates/discount-rate sensitivity, growth/credit conditions, and AI-capex demand sensitivity. Identify dated facts, event timing if documented, and sign-conditional implications; do not forecast policy or assert causality. Stop after the current FOMC material and available FRED observations.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether broad macro/policy conditions materially alter the company and ETF theses relative to fixed SPY and sector benchmarks.
